test_multi_dimensional_tensor: test the MultiDimensionalTensor class by creating padded tensors from uneven-sized input tensors
create_padded_tensor: create a padded tensor from a list of uneven-sized torch tensors using MultiDimensionalTensor.from_tensors
build_mask_from_tensors: build a mask tensor marking padded regions when combining uneven-sized tensors with MultiDimensionalTensor
verify_tensor_shapes: verify the output padded tensor and mask shapes match expected dimensions after from_tensors call
validate_mask_values: validate that mask values are 1.0 for padded indices and 0.0 for valid indices in the output
